issues.title: Event occurrence counts and unit payload totals could be confused
issues.detail: Daytime infected cleanup is emitted as one event containing a count, while infected spawning emits one event per unit.
issues.resolution: GameReport now exposes event_summary.counts separately from event_summary.payload_totals, with regression assertions for both semantics.

issues.title: Real SC2 structure-clearance behavior is not covered by the simulator stage
issues.detail: The Stage 20 plan intentionally forbids promoting simulator output to runtime evidence.
issues.nextAction: Run Stage 21 through the approved launcher with native initialization, typed Vibe actions, runtime listener evidence, and same-window ScriptError verification.
